snippet.title: Screenbreak Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Screenbreak!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857400/Screenbreak/

Your computer’s been infected, and you’re the patch that has to clean it up.

Screenbreak is a top-down bullet hell roguelike set inside a broken PC. Fight your way through folder after folder of corrupted files, zip bombs, popup ads and angry trash cans, then take on bosses like the Antivirus, trash.exe and the Living Launcher.

Every run is different. Pick upgrades after each folder and stack them into builds that get stupid fast: shots that split, bounce, chain lightning, come back like boomerangs, or set everything on fire. Spend your bits in side folder shops, and bring Data Bits home to Pixel for permanent upgrades between runs.

Play with friends. Online co-op for up to 4 players, with built-in voice chat. Pick your Patch’s colour, grab a hat, and hang out in the Cloud lobby before you dive in.

What’s in Early Access:

Endless folders that get harder the deeper you go
60+ upgrades and mega upgrades
3 bosses, with more on the way
Online co-op (2–4 players) with voice chat
Unlockable cosmetics and Steam achievements

Coming during Early Access: story mode, more bosses and enemies, new areas, and whatever the community asks for.

Patch, Pixel and Ping are waiting on your desktop. Don’t let it crash.
